headline: Reliance Industries Showcase Jamnagar Refinery and Digital Hub
summary: Reliance Industries chairperson Mukesh Ambani showcased the conglomerate's Jamnagar refinery alongside new initiatives in data centres and new energy giga factories.
why: Reliance Industries is India's largest conglomerate, operating extensive refining complexes and major telecommunications and digital infrastructure businesses.

impacts.name: Reliance Industries
impacts.why: Expansion into digital infrastructure and green energy initiatives highlights long-term capital allocation strategies.
